company_name: Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd.
model: Bank FCFE at cost of equity (engine route), net debt zero, CET1 retention on risk-weighted-asset growth, perpetual-bond coupons and NCI charged in the flow

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: terminal nominal growth for a mature single-city Chinese bank (China nominal GDP ~4-5% less continued NIM drift and a Chongqing economy growing 4.2%), bracketed by revenue 5yr CAGR 0.3% and BVPS 5yr CAGR 7.0%; the DCF's base revenue path runs 5.0% -> 3.0%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Shareholders' equity 3yr/5yr CAGR 6.6%/8.0% and EPS 5.7%/7.3% vs revenue -0.4%/0.3% (>30% apart). Equity growth is retained earnings on a flat 11,357m share count (plus RMB6.0bn perpetual bonds issued 2021-22 inside the equity line); revenue stalled because NIM fell from 2.74% (FY2016) to 1.60% (FY2025) while total assets grew ~8-10%/yr. EPS grew on falling credit cost (impairment 10.85bn FY2021 -> 5.44bn FY2025) and a falling tax rate, not on revenue. Equity CAGR is NOT used as the growth rate.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are null: a bank's reported FCF (OCF - capex) is deposit-flow noise (OCF -81bn FY2018, +86bn Q1 2026). The relevant series is net profit attributable to shareholders: 10,275.6 (FY2022) -> 10,902.4 -> 11,512.7 -> 12,128.4 (FY2025), +5.7% CAGR, with H1 2026 attributable profit +6.1%. BVPS 9.49 -> 11.58 RMB (FY2022-25), 12.36 at H1 2026. Dividend payout 30.05% of attributable profit in each of FY2023-25 (interim 2026 line 5003-5005); FY2025 DPS RMB0.32091 on 11,357m shares = RMB3.645bn. Operating income grew 7.8% in H1 2026 as NIM ticked up to 1.66% from 1.60% (deposit repricing) - the first increase since FY2016; the base path treats it as stabilisation, not a trend.

scenario_narratives.base: NIM stabilises at ~1.6%, credit cost normalises modestly from the FY2025 low, operating income grows 5% fading to 3% and RWA growth slows from 8% to 3%. CET1 settles at 11.5% (from 12.33% at H1 2026). FCFE is ~RMB6bn in FY2027, dips to ~4bn in FY2028 while RWA growth is still 6% (below the ~3.9bn dividend only briefly), then rises to ~10.5bn by FY2036; terminal ROE ~7.9%, terminal P/B ~0.65x.
scenario_narratives.bull: The H1 2026 margin uptick holds, Chongqing's manufacturing-cluster lending delivers growth without credit losses, cost-to-income falls to ~29%, RWA growth slows to 3.5% and CET1 is run down to 11.0%. FCFE ~RMB6-7bn in FY2027 rising to ~15bn by FY2036; terminal ROE ~9.6%; payout can rise above 30%.
scenario_narratives.bear: A Chongqing property/LGFV credit-cost cycle takes impairment back to the FY2021 level while NIM compresses toward 1.4%; profit falls ~25%; RWA keeps growing on policy lending and CET1 is held at 12.0%, so FCFE is negative in FY2027 and below the dividend until FY2030. Either the dividend is cut or a discounted A-share placement dilutes; terminal ROE ~5.8%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A bank is worth the equity cash flow it can distribute after funding its own capital requirement, discounted at the cost of equity. For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank that flow is net profit to ordinary shareholders (after tax, NCI and perpetual-bond coupons) less the equity retained to hold CET1 at the scenario target on growing risk-weighted assets. The Bank is currently spending the capital buffer it built to 14.24% in FY2024 - RWA grew 16.5% in FY2025 and 10.5% in H1 2026 against ~4-7% growth in CET1 capital - so on its actual trajectory FY2026E FCFE is roughly zero and the 5.9% dividend yield is being financed by ratio drift. The model lets the ratio settle at 11.5% (base), decelerates RWA growth to 3% and credits only the resulting FCFE. Net debt is zero by construction; deposits are operating funding. The H share trades at ~0.44x H1 2026 book (RMB12.36 = HKD14.51) and ~5.2x FY2025 earnings; the base terminal P/B is ~0.65x, consistent with a ~7.9% ROE at a 10.5% cost of equity.
key_risks_to_valuation: Capital: CET1 fell 1.9pt in 18 months (14.24% -> 12.33%) because RWA growth (10-16%) runs at 2-4x what retained earnings can fund after a 30% payout. Every scenario assumes RWA growth decelerates to <=8% in FY2027; if the Bank keeps growing RWA 15% the 11.5% target is breached by FY2028 and a discounted A-share placement (which the flat share count does not model) becomes the base case.

Concentration: ~100% of the loan book, deposits and collateral are in one municipality; Chongqing property (mortgages ~11% of loans, developer NPLs rising per the Analysis), LGFV/municipal-project lending and the manufacturing-cluster strategy are correlated exposures. The bear margin path (36% trough) is the FY2020-21 credit-cost experience repeated.

NIM: 2.74% (FY2016) to 1.60% (FY2025); management guides only to 'reasonable and stable operation' and expects rates to 'remain at a low level' in H2 2026 (interim line 3206). The H1 2026 uptick to 1.66% is treated as stabilisation; if it reverses, the bear revenue path applies.

Sector overhang: the NFRA's consolidation of weak rural and village banks and Fitch's ~2.8% sector NPL cap the multiple investors will pay for any 'rural commercial bank' H share regardless of CQRCB's own metrics; this is charged in the cost of equity and the bear weight, not in the flows.

Tax and coupons: the ~9-15% effective tax rate depends on tax-exempt government-bond income; a shift of the book toward loans lifts the rate toward 20%+ (each 5pt is ~RMB0.75bn of FCFE). RMB238m of perpetual coupons are senior to ordinary dividends.

Governance and currency: municipal-SASAC-linked control, policy Sannong/inclusive-finance lending quotas, payout set by policy (30.05% three years running) and no buyback lever; RMB flows against an HKD quote so a 10% RMB move is a 10% move in the HKD value; the 10% H-share dividend withholding tax is not modelled.

Sell-side: UBS HKD 8.35 target (Mar 2026) sits between this base case and the weighted value; the gap to the base case is the model's assumption that RWA growth decelerates fast enough for CET1 to hold at 11.5% without a raise.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (3618.HK, HKD) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 5.62-7.30. FX CNYHKD=X, USDCNY=X, USDHKD=X and 601077.SS from the same API on the same date.
data_sources.financials: 3618.HK_Metrics.csv / metrics_normalized (FY2016-FY2025 annual, H1 2022-H1 2026 interim, Q1/Q3 quarterlies, RMB millions) built from the HKEX annual and interim reports in Extracted/; kpis table for NIM, NPL, coverage, CET1/Tier1/CAR, ROE, ROA, cost-to-income, deposits, dividends paid, NCI profit, PBT, BVPS. FY2025 annual report: capital adequacy table (RWA 1,034,810.7, net CET1 131,118.9, lines 2609-2664), income statement (operating income 28,620.0, impairment 5,444.1, tax 1,289.4, NCI 291.6), dividend section (lines 6640-6668), perpetual bonds (note 35, 4.00%/3.90% on RMB6.0bn, coupons 238m line 12424), weighted shares 11,357,000 thousand (line 12390), outlook XI (line 4663). H1 2026 interim: capital table (CET1 12.33%, RWA 1,143,036.6, lines 4196-4236), income statement (operating income 15,881.8 line 386, impairment 1,993.0 line 6063, PBT 9,889.4, NCI 175.1), dividends and 30.05% payout table (lines 4972-5005), share count 11,357,000,000 (line 5473), NIM outlook (line 3206), Outlook VII (line 4350), Capital Planning 2026-2028 (line 4187).
data_sources.qualitative: 3618.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-22), read before the drivers were set: single-city concentration, NIM 2.74% -> 1.60%, CET1 decline, payout >=30%, property/LGFV exposure, rural-bank consolidation wave, UBS HKD 8.35 target, CSI 300 / MSCI China H inclusion. It confirmed the drivers without moving any path.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E operating income, RMB m: H1 2026 actual 15,881.8 (interim line 386, +7.78% YoY) + H2 2026E 14,578 (FY2025 H2 actual 13,884.2 x 1.05). FY2025 actual 28,620.0. Operating income = net interest income + net fee and commission income + other non-interest income, the Bank's own top line.
inputs.share_count_basis: 11,357,000,000 ordinary shares (A + H, one class, same economic rights; interim line 5473), of which ~2,513m are H shares (H-share interim dividend RMB511m / RMB0.20336). Weighted average = basic = diluted 11,357,000 thousand every year since FY2019 (FY2025 annual line 12390). Held FLAT: no share scheme, no convertible, no preference shares; the RMB6.0bn perpetual bonds are non-convertible (interim note 37). A discounted A-share placement to replenish CET1 is the dilution the flat count ignores (see notes).
inputs.debt_cash_note: Bank: customer deposits (RMB1.089tn at 30 Jun 2026), borrowings from the central bank (RMB102.5bn), interbank funding and debt securities issued are operating funding, and cash/central-bank balances are liquidity, not surplus. Net debt is zero by construction on the FCFE route and nothing is bridged after the flows. The parser's NULL total_debt is correct for this model.
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2026E FCFE on the BASE capital target: net profit to ORDINARY shareholders ~12,425 (PBT 14,970 at 49.1% margin less income tax ~13%, NCI ~2.4% and perpetual-bond coupons 238m = 17% of PBT) LESS the equity needed to hold CET1 at 11.5% on FY2026E RWA 1,205bn versus FY2025 net CET1 131,119 (0.115 x 1,205,000 - 131,119 = 7,456). On the Bank's ACTUAL FY2026E trajectory (CET1 ratio ~11.9%, net CET1 ~143.4bn) it retained ~12.3bn, i.e. FCFE was ~zero and the ~RMB3.8bn ordinary dividend was financed by running the ratio down 0.8pt in the year (and 1.9pt since FY2024). Reported OCF - capex (FY2025: 372 - 1,732) is deposit and interbank flow noise and is not used; the CSV's NULL free_cash_flow is correct.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero: no share-based payment scheme, share option or employee share plan disclosed in the FY2018-FY2025 annual reports or the H1 2026 interim; basic = diluted EPS (RMB1.05 FY2025); no share repurchases. House and street bases coincide; band_position is degenerate (null).
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate converts CNY (model; the Bank reports in RMB) to HKD (H-share quote): CNYHKD=X 1.1738 at 2026-10-22T10:49Z, Yahoo Finance. Triangulated against USDCNY=X 6.6626 / USDHKD=X 7.8404 = 1.1768 (same source, same day). The Shanghai A share (601077.SS) closed at CNY 7.04 = HKD 8.26, a ~29% A/H premium that is normal for Chinese banks, so the dual listing is not a parity check. Per-share values are per ordinary share and apply equally to A and H shares; H-share dividends are declared in RMB and paid in HKD (or RMB by election).
inputs.fy0: FY2026E (year ending 2026-12-31, unreported: H1 2026 actual + H2 estimate)
inputs.cet1_anchor: CET1 ratio 12.33% on RWA RMB1,143,036.6m at 30 Jun 2026 (interim lines 4229-4232; net CET1 140,969.8); 12.67% on 1,034,810.7 at FY2025 (annual lines 2609-2612; net CET1 131,118.9); 14.24% on 888,052.6 at FY2024. RWA grew 16.5% in FY2025 and 10.5% in H1 2026 alone while net CET1 grew 3.7% and 7.5%: the ratio is falling because RWA growth is running at 2-4x the rate retained earnings can fund. Tier 1 12.87%, total CAR 14.07%, leverage ratio ~8%. Regulatory minimum for a non-D-SIB: CET1 7.5%, Tier 1 8.5%, total 10.5% (the Bank is not on the PBOC/NFRA D-SIB list). Management discloses that its 2026-2028 Capital Planning 'set planning target values for capital adequacy ratios at each tier' but does not publish them (annual lines 2549-2551; interim line 4187).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Single CNY cost of equity 10.5% in every scenario (risk is charged once, through the scenario weights, not by moving the discount rate). Built in the flows' own currency: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8% (ASSUMPTION: not fetched; the PBOC easing cycle has kept the 10Y CGB in the 1.6-2.0% range since 2025) + beta ~1.0 x China ERP ~6.5% = ~8.3%, plus ~2.2pt for risks a CSI-300 ERP does not price for an H-share holder in a SINGLE-CITY rural commercial bank: ~100% of the book in Chongqing (property, '33618' manufacturing clusters, municipal projects, LGFVs); the rural-commercial-bank sector overhang (NFRA consolidation wave, sector NPL ~2.8% per Fitch) that caps the H-share multiple regardless of CQRCB's own 1.05% NPL; RWA growth (16.5% FY2025, 10.5% H1 2026) running far ahead of capital generation so that the 30% payout is being financed by CET1 drift; policy-directed Sannong/inclusive lending that allocates RWA to state objectives; state/municipal control via Chongqing SASAC-linked shareholders with no buyback lever; and capital-account/RMB risk. Set EQUAL to the 10.5% used for 0998.HK (CITIC Bank, 2026-10-12) rather than the 11% used for 2016.HK (Zheshang): CQRCB's CET1 buffer (12.3% vs ~9.4%, ~4.8pt above its minimum vs ~1.4pt) and provisioning (357% coverage vs ~200%) are far stronger than a joint-stock bank's, which offsets the concentration and sector-overhang premium a regional bank deserves. Hurdle for entry price is the house 15%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Lease liabilities RMB164m (FY2025 annual line 9850) are immaterial against RMB1.67tn of assets and are inside operating expenses; lease_cost_pct_path 0, nothing bridged.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests (12 village and township banks, CQRC Financial Leasing, CQRC Wealth Management) took RMB291.6m of FY2025 profit (2.1% of PBT) and RMB175.1m in H1 2026 (1.8%); charged inside cash_tax_rate_path so EBIT x (1 - rate) is profit to ORDINARY shareholders. NCI equity RMB2.3bn is not bridged (the flows are already net of it).
inputs.notes: MODEL: bank -> dcf-methods routing row 'Bank, non-bank deposit taker, thrift'. Run as FCFE at cost of equity through the component engine, the house precedent for banks (HSBC, LYG, WF, MFG, HDB, IBN, BMO, USB, WFC, NAB.AX, 0939.HK, 0998.HK, 2016.HK, 1658.HK). First valuation of this ticker, no MEMORY.md entry. IDENTITY: Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank (H 03618 / A 601077), NOT China Merchants Bank; confirmed from the filing covers and the RMB1.67tn asset base. Not an owner-FCF DCF: deposits are operating funding, OCF is meaningless (swings from -81bn to +86bn), net debt is zero by construction and no debt or cash is bridged. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = operating income; ebitda_margin = pre-tax profit margin (after credit impairment, which is the real cost of a bank); sbc, D&A, leases and working capital all zero; cash_tax_rate = income tax + NCI + perpetual-bond coupons (RMB238m/yr: 4.00% on 4bn + 3.90% on 2bn, interim note 37), so EBIT x (1 - rate) = net profit to ORDINARY shareholders; capex = equity retained to hold CET1 at the scenario target on RWA growth (CET1_t x RWA_t - CET1_t-1 x RWA_t-1, as % of operating income), so FCF = FCFE = distributable earnings. Terminal growth applies to FCFE at the cost of equity; terminal_cap_multiple 18x FCFE is above the Gordon multiple in every scenario and does not bind. CAPITAL TARGET (the key judgment): the Bank ran CET1 up to 14.24% (FY2024) and is now deliberately deploying it, down to 12.33% at H1 2026 with no published floor. Base holds 11.5% from FY2027 (a ~4pt buffer over the 7.5% minimum, where the Bank sat while growing in FY2018-20 and still ~2pt above joint-stock peers); the 0.4pt release from the FY2026E ~11.9% is embedded in FY2027 retention. Bull steps to 11.0% in FY2028; bear holds 12.0% (no further release while credit costs spike). KEY FINDING: at the FY2025-H1 2026 pace of RWA growth (10-16%) the Bank cannot fund both growth and the 30% payout from earnings: holding CET1 flat on 10% RWA growth consumes ~RMB14bn against ~RMB12.5bn of ordinary profit. Every scenario therefore decelerates RWA growth (base 8% -> 3%); the dividend is covered by FCFE only once RWA growth falls below ~6%. A 2-3 year continuation of 15% RWA growth is the path to a discounted A-share placement, which the flat share count does not model. FY2026E tax: H1 2026 effective income tax 15.6% vs 9.4% for FY2025 (H2 2025 was 5.5% on tax-exempt government-bond interest); FY2026E ~13% + NCI 2.4% + coupons 1.6% = 17%, base path 17.5% to allow the exempt-bond share to keep falling. Valuation date is 9.7 months into FY2026, so FY2026E is fy0 (not discounted) and the first discounted flow is FY2027; the FY2025 final dividend (RMB1.335bn, Jun/Jul 2026) and the FY2026 interim (declared Dec 2026, paid Jan 2027) are paid out of fy0 and are not double-counted.

bear.growth_rationale: NIM resumes compressing toward 1.4% (further LPR cuts, deposit costs sticky in a county retail base), fee income keeps falling; revenue repeats the FY2021-25 stall (-1.9% CAGR).
bear.margin_rationale: A Chongqing property/LGFV credit-cost cycle: impairment returns to the FY2021 level (10.85bn, 35% of income) in FY2028-29 - the FY2020 margin was 35.7% at the COVID credit-cost peak - then partly recovers to 41% as the 357% coverage cushion is consumed.
bear.capex_rationale: No capital release: CET1 held at 12.0% while policy-directed lending keeps RWA growing 7.0, 5.0, 4.0, 3.0, 3.0, 2.5, 2.5, 2.0, 2.0, 2.0%. FY2027 retention 11.3bn against ~10.3bn of ordinary profit (FCFE negative, ~-1bn, versus a ~3.8bn dividend). In practice this is the scenario where the dividend is cut or a discounted A-share placement dilutes the H share; the flat share count understates the damage. Terminal ROE on CET1 ~5.8%.
bear.tax_rationale: Fixed perpetual coupons and NCI against a smaller PBT, and less tax-exempt bond income as the book shifts to loans.
bear.terminal_note: Gordon 1.02/0.085 = 12.0x FCFE; cap does not bind.
bear.narrative: A Chongqing credit-cost cycle plus continued NIM compression. Earnings fall ~25%, the capital ratio cannot support both growth and the dividend, and value accrues to the municipality's lending priorities rather than minority H-share holders.

base.growth_rationale: Operating income +5% in FY2027 fading to 3%: NIM stabilises at ~1.6% (H1 2026 1.66%, +6bp YoY after -114bp over nine years), balance sheet growing ~8% slowing to ~4%, fee income flat (H1 2026 +5%). Below RWA growth in the early years, so NI/RWA keeps drifting down as the mix shifts to corporate loans.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin after credit impairment. FY2023 43.6%, FY2024 45.4%, FY2025 47.9%, FY2026E 49.1% (H1 62.3% vs 60.2% a year earlier; H2 is seasonally ~25pt lower as impairments are booked). Base eases to 47%: credit cost normalises up from the FY2025 low (impairment 5.44bn, 19% of income, vs 10.85bn in FY2021), cost-to-income ~31%, no NIM recovery. 357% provision coverage is a cushion the model does not release.
base.capex_rationale: Equity retained to hold CET1 at 11.5% on RWA growth of 8.0, 6.0, 5.0, 4.5, 4.0, 3.5, 3.0, 3.0, 3.0, 3.0% from FY2026E RWA RMB1,205bn (FY2025 1,034.8bn; H1 2026 1,143.0bn) and FY2026E net CET1 ~143.4bn (11.9%). FY2027 retention 6.3bn = 0.115 x 1,301.4bn - 143.4bn (includes the 0.4pt release to the 11.5% target); FY2028 9.0bn; converging on 0.03 x 0.115 x prior RWA = 6.1bn in FY2036 (14.2% of income). Terminal-year CET1 ~RMB211bn on RWA 1,834bn; terminal ROE on CET1 ~7.9%.
base.tax_rationale: Income tax ~13% (FY2026E; FY2025 9.4%, H1 2026 15.6% - low and volatile because of tax-exempt government-bond interest) + NCI ~2.4% + perpetual-bond coupons 238m ~1.6% of PBT = ~17%, set at 17.5% to allow the tax-exempt share to keep shrinking. Coupons are fixed in RMB so their share falls as PBT grows; ignored (conservative).
base.terminal_note: Gordon on FY2036 FCFE at 10.5% - 3.0% = 13.7x; the 18x cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B on CET1 ~0.65x at terminal ROE ~7.9%, consistent with (ROE - g)/(CoE - g).
base.narrative: Steady-state regional bank: NIM holds ~1.6%, credit cost normalises modestly, RWA growth decelerates from 8% to 3% and CET1 settles at 11.5%. FCFE is ~RMB6bn in FY2027 (covered dividend ~3.9bn) but only ~4bn in FY2028 as RWA growth is still 6%, then rises to ~10.5bn by FY2036 as retention falls.

bull.growth_rationale: The H1 2026 NIM uptick (1.60% -> 1.66%) holds as deposit repricing completes and the PBOC easing cycle ends; corporate loan growth in the '33618' manufacturing clusters and the Land-Sea Corridor stays double-digit; fund-custody and wealth-management fees grow.
bull.margin_rationale: Credit cost stays at the FY2025 low (~0.6% of loans), NPL keeps improving from 1.05%, cost-to-income ~29%; 51% is roughly FY2026E plus 2pt of operating leverage.
bull.capex_rationale: CET1 target 11.5% in FY2027 then 11.0% from FY2028 (a ~3.5pt buffer over the 7.5% minimum, still above joint-stock peers) on RWA growth of 8.0, 6.0, 5.0, 4.5, 4.0, 4.0, 3.5, 3.5, 3.5, 3.5%. The FY2028 step to 11.0% releases ~6.9bn, which is why that year's retention is only 2.1bn (6.0% of income). Terminal ROE on CET1 ~9.6%.
bull.tax_rationale: Tax-exempt bond income keeps the effective tax rate ~12-13%; fixed coupons fall to ~1.3% of a larger PBT.
bull.terminal_note: Gordon 1.035/0.07 = 14.8x FCFE; cap 18x does not bind.
bull.narrative: Chongqing's manufacturing-cluster strategy delivers: NIM and credit cost both hold, operating income grows 7% fading to 3.5%, RWA growth slows to 3.5% and CET1 can be run down to 11.0% without a raise, so the payout can rise above 30%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the house default 15%, below the 35% used for 0998.HK/CITIC): CQRCB's capital (CET1 12.33%, ~4.8pt above its minimum), asset quality (NPL 1.05% and improving, coverage 357%) and ten years of ROE >9% argue for less downside weight than a joint-stock bank, but a single-city book exposed to Chongqing property, LGFVs and the '33618' manufacturing clusters, RWA growth of 10-16% that the earnings cannot fund alongside a 30% payout, and the rural-bank-sector overhang on the H-share multiple argue for well above the default. Bull 20%: the H1 2026 NIM uptick is one half-year against nine years of compression, and the policy-lending mandate caps upside. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
